episodeTitle.en: Inside Etsy’s product, growth, and marketplace evolution | Tim Holley (VP of Product)
episodeTitle.zh: Etsy产品、增长与市场演进之路 | 蒂姆·霍利（VP of Product）

guestBioOfficial.en: Tim Holley is VP of Product at Etsy where he leads the Etsy buyer experience. With a tenure spanning more than a decade, Tim has seen the company through many transitions (both in culture, in leadership, and in growth), and his team’s product changes have had a significant impact on buyer retention, conversion, and global expansion. In this episode, we discuss: • Lessons from navigating corporate culture shifts
guestBioOfficial.zh: 蒂姆·霍利（Tim Holley）是Etsy的VP of Product，负责领导Etsy买家体验部门。凭借十余年的从业经验，蒂姆见证了公司在文化、领导层及增长方面的诸多变革，其团队的产品创新对买家留存、转化率及全球扩张产生了重大影响。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：•从企业文化变革中吸取的经验教训

title.en: Inside Etsy’s product, growth, and marketplace evolution | Tim Holley (VP of Product)
title.zh: Etsy产品、增长与市场演进之路 | 蒂姆·霍利（VP of Product）

summary.en: Tim shares the big cultural transition Etsy went through as it scaled, and the product and marketplace moves that drove its growth from $500M to $13B+ in GMV. He discusses how to change internal culture, where to find leverage in a two-sided marketplace, and advice for anyone working on marketplaces or seeking growth ideas. The episode is a rare inside look at scaling one of the world's most distinctive marketplaces.
summary.zh: Tim 分享了 Etsy 在规模化过程中经历的重大文化转型，以及推动其 GMV 从 5 亿增长到 130 多亿美元的产品与市场动作。他讨论了如何改变内部文化、在双边市场中何处寻找杠杆，以及给所有做市场平台或寻求增长思路之人的建议。本期是对规模化全球最具特色市场平台之一的罕见内部透视。
